College (Autonomous), Bengaluru, Karnataka with certain conditions. The recommendation of UGC Expert Committee was

deemed to be University under general category in the name of Mount Carmel, Bengaluru, Karnataka. The said declaration is

2023, as amended from time to time. 


iv. There shall be no diversion of assets or funds/revenues of the Institution deemed to be University/or of its 
constituent teaching units, without prior permission of the UGC and Ministry of Education.

कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने

4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था

MINISTRY OF PERSONNEL, PUBLIC GRIEVANCES AND PENSIONS 
(Department of Personnel and Training) 
New Delhi, the 8th June, 2026 


G.S.R. 119.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, 
and in supersession of the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Department of 
Personnel and Training, the Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration, Mussoorie, Senior 
Private Secretary, Group ‘B’ Post Recruitment Rules, 2017, except as respects things done or omitted to be 
done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of 
recruitment to the post of Senior Private Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and 
Pensions, Department of Personnel and Training, Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of 
Administration, Mussoorie, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Personnel, Public 
Grievances and Pensions, Department of Personnel and Training, the Lal Bahadur Shastri National 
Academy of Administration, Mussoorie, Senior Private Secretary, (Group ‘B’ Post) Recruitment 
Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix. - The number of the said post, its 


classification and level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) 
of the schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit and qualification, etc. - The method of recruitment, age limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) 
of the said Schedule. 

4. Disqualification. - No person,- 


(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible 
under the personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there 
are other grounds for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient 
so to do, it may, by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing, and in consultation with the Union 
Public Service Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or 
category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age-limit and other 
concessions required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, Other 
Backward Classes, Ex-Servicemen and other special category of persons in accordance with the 
orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

G.S.R. 120.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, and in 
supersession of the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, 
Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare Recruitment Rules, 2017, except as respects things 
done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the 
method of recruitment to the post of Economic Officer in the Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division in the 
Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement.- (i) These rules may be called the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers 
Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division, Economic 
Officer Recruitment Rules, 2025. 


(ii) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification and Level in the Pay Matrix. — The number of the said post, its 
classification and the Level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the 
Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. — The method of recruitment, age limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Disqualification.- No person - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 


(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible 
for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule.

G.S.R. 121.— In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the National Institute of Communicable Diseases, National Filaria Control Programme and National 
Malaria Eradication Programme (Class I and Class H, Non-medical, Gazetted posts) Recruitment Rules, 1976 in so 
far as they relate to the post of Research Officer (Veterinary) National Institute of Communicable Diseases, except as 
respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules 
regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Deputy Assistant Director (Veterinary) in the National Centre for 
Disease Control, under the Directorate General of Health Service, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, namely: 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 
National Centre for Disease Control, Deputy Assistant Director (Veterinary) Group ‘A’ Post Recruitment Rules, 
2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix. - The number of the said post, its classification and 
the level in the pay matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the said Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Method of Recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. — The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualifications — No person, 

(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person having a spouse living, or 
(b) Who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing, and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect, reservations, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required 
to be provided for the Schedule Castes, the Schedule Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the ex-Servicemen and 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.

4. Disqualification. - No person,- 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post:

applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any

may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any

this regard.

G.S.R. 123.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the College of Nursing, New Delhi (Class II posts) Recruitment Rules, 1971, in so far as they relate 
to the post of Stenographer(Junior), except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the 
President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Stenographer Grade-II 
in the Rajkumari Amrit Kaur College of Nursing, New Delhi, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, namely: - 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Health and Family 
Welfare, Rajkumari Amrit Kaur College of Nursing, New Delhi, Stenographer Grade-II (Group ‘C’ Post ) 
Recruitment Rules, 2026.

2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix. - The number of the said post, its classification and 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these 
rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. - The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications 
and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. - No person,- 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any 
class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required 
to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, other backward classes, ex-servicemen and other 
special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in 
this regard.

New Delhi, the 2nd June, 2026 


G.S.R. 124.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, and in 
supersession of the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Professor (Sugar Engineering), Assistant Professor(Sugar 
Engineering), Lecturer(Sugar Engineering), Assistant Engineer (Electrical / Mechanical Engineering) and Senior 
Research Assistant (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment Rules, 2017, in so far as they relate to the post of 
Assistant Professor (Sugar Engineering) except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such 
supersession, the president hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of 
Assistant Professor (Sugar Engineering) in the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, 
Food and Public Distributions, Department of Food and Public Distribution, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Assistant 
Professor (Sugar Engineering) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix. — The number of the post, its classification and level in 
the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.— The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the aforesaid Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person,- 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, 
exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. -Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, 
by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, ex-servicemen and other categories of persons in 
accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Technical Assistant (Sugar Technology) in the National 
Sugar Institute, Kanpur in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Food and 
Public Distribution, namely :- 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the National Sugar Institute, Technical Assistant 
(Sugar Technology), Group ‘C’ Post Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.

3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.- The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule.

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 
Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 


applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule.

2. और जबकि, यूजीसी ने अपने दिनांक 12.05.2026 के पत्र संख्या 41-5/2026 (सीपीपी-आई/डीयू) के माध्यम से सूचित किया कि 
आवेदन की स्थायी समिति के माध्यम से जांच की गई थी। समिति ने संस्थान की प्रस्तुति के बाद और प्रस्तुत दस्तावेजों के आधार पर, कुछ शर्तों 
को पूरा करने के लिए ASAT VST (एमआर), तेलंगाना को आशय पत्र (एलओआई) जारी करने की सिफारिश की। 


3. और जबकि, मंत्रालय ने यूजीसी की सलाह पर, Aca Vet (THA), सम विश्वविद्यालय, तेलंगाना को कृष्णापुरम गांव, रेनिगुंटा

आशय पत्र (एलओआई) जारी किया। 


4. और इसके अलावा जबकि, पंजीयक, Heat Tet (WHS), तेलंगाना ने दिनांक 02.06.2026 को एलओआई में निर्धारित शर्तों के 
संबंध में अनुपालन रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत की। इसे सत्यापन और आगे की सलाह हेतु यूजीसी को भेजा गया था। इसके अलावा, यूजीसी ने दिनांक
